name: Arcas vom Norden

facts.label: Parents
facts.value: Cliff vom Grand Kevin x Kaya Jibaya von Bachbett

bio: Arcas was born on May 8, 2024.  He was the smallest of 3 puppies in the Cliff x Jibaya litter but quickly caught up and is now 20+ pounds larger than Aurora or Astraeus (Lugh) at 93 pounds.  He's 18 months old in the main photo, is my personal Service Dog and is absolutely perfect, my best friend. He strongly resembles his Police K9 sire Cliff vom Grand Kevin in size and head structure/facial appearance especially.  He's obsessed with balls of all sizes, types, sounds, materials -- if it's a ball, he can't stop chasing and playing with it.  Arcas easily passed his CGC test on March 21, 2026 and is now getting started on agility.
